page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.10xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 40 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 20 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 9.6 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the average tier across multiple metrics. The Intel Xeon processor delivers a single-core stress-ng score of 1436.39 and a multi-core score of 38318.39, supported by AVX-512 vector extensions. Memory performance is highlighted by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 2128.36 GB/sec, which drops to 111.38 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. The system handles database operations effectively, achieving a PassMark database score of 14328.81 and a Redis SET throughput of 32.74 million operations per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfr6.10xlarge offers a balanced profile for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities, though the lack of integrated storage requires external block storage provisioning. This configuration is well-suited for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise applications, and moderate-scale data processing tasks.
